description: Python package to work with Semantic Versioning (https://semver.org/)
commit_message:
Compare long numeric prerelease identifiers without integer conversion (#488)

Problem: Large numeric prereleases (~5,000 digits) parsed successfully
but triggered a ValueError during comparison due to Python's
integer-conversion limits.

Solution: Numeric prereleases are now compared using normalized
digit counts and text matching instead of integer conversion,
preserving numeric-before-text ordering.

Unchanged Behavior: Retains constructor leading-zero comparisons,
legacy Unicode handling, eager validation, core version parsing, and
release/build precedence.

Deliverables: Includes regression tests and a changelog update.
